implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Defines RESTful routes for events, enabling listing, detail, creation, editing, and removal.
implementation.name: resources :events
implementation.pseudo_code:
GET /events -> index
GET /events/:id -> show
GET /events/new -> new
POST /events -> create
GET /events/:id/edit -> edit
PATCH/PUT /events/:id -> update
DELETE /events/:id -> destroy

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Handles event creation, including user assignment and feedback messaging.
implementation.name: EventsController#create
implementation.pseudo_code:
Set @event = Event.new(event_params)
IF @event.save:
  Redirect to event with notice
ELSE:
  Fetch users
  Render new with errors

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Fetches the user list from an external API for assignment to events.
implementation.name: JsonplaceholderService.fetch_users
implementation.pseudo_code:
IF cache expired:
  GET https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users
  IF response 200:
    Return parsed user list
  ELSE:
    Return []
ELSE:
  Return cached user list

Read assigned_user_ids attribute
IF blank:

ELSE:
  Parse JSON and return array

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Returns user objects for all assigned user IDs by fetching from the external service.
implementation.name: Event#assigned_users
implementation.pseudo_code:
IF assigned_user_ids blank:
  Return []
ELSE:
  FOR each id in assigned_user_ids:
    Fetch user from JsonplaceholderService
  Return non-nil users
